# Version 3.14.0 (September 22, 2026)

## General

1. [`458189298`](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/commit/458189298) Added the `ipc` [flag](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/XMLreference.html#option-flag-ipc), an experimental contact mode of the `discrete`
   integrator for penetration-free flex contact. Each step minimizes an incremental potential subject to linearized
   contact constraints, using a barrier-free augmented Lagrangian whose subproblems are the discrete solve. Every
   committed position update is verified intersection-free by continuous collision detection, so flex contact cannot
   tunnel. Supported for dim-2 flexes: a flex with edge equality constraints keeps its elasticity in the constraint
   solver, while `elastic2d` elasticity is integrated implicitly through the effective metric. The contacts the mode
   resolves are frictionless. The mode keeps contact multipliers across steps that no state specification covers, so
   `mj_getState`/`mj_setState` do not capture its full state and exact replay is not supported.

2. [`2fec92237`](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/commit/2fec92237) Introduced [archive resource providers](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/functions.html#mjp_registerArchiveResourceProvider)
   (`mjp_registerArchiveResourceProvider`). Archive providers use the
   [`mjpResourceProvider`](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/APItypes.html#mjpResourceProvider) interface to mount and read archive containers (such as
   `.mjz`/`.zip`), decoupling container handling from format decoders and enabling
   on-demand asset extraction without requiring a pre-allocated [VFS](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/functions_override.html#Virtualfilesystem).

3. [`e312ce82d`](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/commit/e312ce82d) [Frames](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/XMLreference.html#frame) are now preserved when saving MJCF: `<frame>` elements are written with
   their `pos` and `quat` and their contents in frame-relative coordinates, so a saved model reloads with the same
   frames. Previously the frame transformation was accumulated into the children on save and only the frame's name was
   kept. Changes to the `pos` or `quat` of a frame in an [`mjSpec`](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/APItypes.html#mjSpec) now also take effect when the spec is
   recompiled.

## Engine

> [!WARNING]
> **Breaking API changes**
>
> 4. [`dc8bb1364`](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/commit/dc8bb1364) [`mj_readCtrl`](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/functions_override.html#mj_readCtrl) now matches the signature and semantics of [`mj_readSensor`](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/functions_override.html#mj_readSensor) to support
>    multi-input actuators (e.g., [pid](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/XMLreference.html#actuator-pid), [dcmotor](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/XMLreference.html#actuator-dcmotor),
>    [orientation](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/XMLreference.html#actuator-orientation)): it takes an output buffer `result` of size `actuator_ctrlnum[id]`
>    and returns `const mjtNum*` (a pointer into `mjData.ctrl` or `mjData.history` on zero-order-hold or exact
>    timestamp matches, or `NULL` when interpolated values are written to `result`). Actuator history buffers now
>    store `actuator_ctrlnum[id]` values per sample, and [`mj_initCtrlHistory`](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/functions_override.html#mj_initCtrlHistory) expects `nsample *
>    actuator_ctrlnum[id]` values ([#3597](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/issues/3597)).

5. [`9e0c6b577`](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/commit/9e0c6b577) The [mjWARN_INERTIA](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/APItypes.html#mjtWarning) warning is now also raised by the modified-inertia
   factorizations of the `implicitfast` and damped-`Euler` integrators (previously silent) and of the
   `implicit` integrator (previously a fatal error).

6. [`35c0631de`](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/commit/35c0631de) The sparse Newton solver no longer aborts with a "rank-deficient sparse Hessian" error when
   rounding loses a pivot of its Hessian, as can happen in single precision with ill-conditioned inertia. The pivot is
   now clamped and its row decoupled, as in the dense factorization.

## Bug fixes

7. [`2a3f1f5a4`](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/commit/2a3f1f5a4) Procedural model editing is no longer quadratic in the number of elements. `mjSpec` previously
   recomputed the compilation signature on every [`mjs_addGeom`](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/functions.html#mjs_addGeom)-like call, and [`mjs_setName`](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/functions.html#mjs_setName) rescanned every
   name of the element's type. Both are now incremental. Building a spec with 8000 geoms is roughly 10x faster.

> [!WARNING]
> **Breaking API changes**
>
> `mjsElement.signature` is now `0` whenever the spec has been structurally edited since it was last compiled,
> rather than being eagerly recomputed on each edit. It is still equal to `mjModel.signature` after a successful
> [`mj_compile`](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/functions_override.html#mj_compile), which is what [`mj_copyBack`](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/functions.html#mj_copyBack) and the Python `bind` methods rely on. Code that compared the
> signature of an uncompiled spec against anything other than `0` must compile first. Additionally, when
> [`mjs_setName`](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/functions.html#mjs_setName) fails on a duplicate name, the element's previous name is now preserved rather than being
> overwritten with the duplicate name.

8. [`ac329bd17`](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/commit/ac329bd17) Fixed the torque applied by [weld](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/XMLreference.html#equality-weld) constraints in
   [`mj_rnePostConstraint`](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/functions_override.html#mj_rnePostConstraint). The rotational constraint force was used directly as a world-frame torque, missing the
   scaling by `0.5 * torquescale` and the rotation into the world frame. [Force](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/XMLreference.html#sensor-force) and
   [torque](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/XMLreference.html#sensor-torque) sensors on bodies held by a weld that carries torque were wrong ([#2533](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/issues/2533)).

9. [`263c638c0`](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/commit/263c638c0) [`mj_rnePostConstraint`](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/functions_override.html#mj_rnePostConstraint) now accounts for the forces of spatial tendons (spring, damper,
   actuator, limit, friction loss, equality and armature), so [force](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/XMLreference.html#sensor-force) and
   [torque](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/XMLreference.html#sensor-torque) sensors register the forces that tendons apply to bodies ([#832](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/issues/832)).

10. [`eb662fcaf`](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/commit/eb662fcaf) Tendon [actuatorfrclimited](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/XMLreference.html#tendon-spatial-actuatorfrclimited) now defaults to "auto" as
    documented. Previously the default was "false" and `actuatorfrcrange` was silently ignored unless
    `actuatorfrclimited` was set explicitly.

11. [`54be9cce6`](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/commit/54be9cce6) [`mjd_transitionFD`](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/functions_override.html#mjd_transitionFD) and [`mjd_inverseFD`](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/functions_override.html#mjd_inverseFD) now raise an error when
    [sleeping](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/computation/index.html#Sleeping) is enabled. Previously, their repeated evaluations changed the sleep state, leading to
    internal errors or wrong derivatives.

12. [`e38573c64`](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/commit/e38573c64) Fixed a memory leak in [`mjs_delete`](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/functions.html#mjs_delete) where deleted elements and subtrees were retained in
    `mjSpec` until [`mj_deleteSpec`](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/APIreference/functions.html#mj_deleteSpec) ([#2882](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/issues/2882)).

13. [`65ea54c3c`](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco/commit/65ea54c3c) Fixed an out-of-bounds read when parsing the header of a [GMSH file](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/search.html?q=gmsh-file-docs) loaded
    by [flexcomp](https://mujoco.readthedocs.io/en/stable/XMLreference.html#body-flexcomp). Truncated headers are now reported as an error.
